description: php.ini security audit — Offline security audit of a php.ini (or .user.ini / PHP-FPM php_admin_value lines): allow_url_include, display_errors, disable_functions, open_basedir, session cookie flags and strict mode, trans_sid, Xdebug, phar.readonly, auto_prepend_file persistence, memory/upload limits, cgi.fix_pathinfo and more. Unset directives are judged by PHP 8 defaults. Returns findings with fixes, score, grade, verdict (PASS/REVIEW/FIX BEFORE DEPLOY/BLOCK) and a hardened example. Params: text= (required), env=production|development. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description:
expose_php = On
display_errors = On
allow_url_include = On
session.use_strict_mode = 0

name: security_php_ini_check
